rationale: Variant c was the spine (best weighted score, show-the-answer routes, clean trap coverage). Its stems that replayed S4 to S7 (HIDA vs ultrasound, 6-8 week key, TG18 grade plan, silent stones, Charcot, gas organism, critical view, acalculous, site pairing) were rewritten as new forms, including the reversed gas-free organism stem from a. lesson: A consolidation segment wins by re-testing each trap in a new stem form (reversed, correction, NOT with matched feedback), not by replaying earlier items, with key position and length varied.
